text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that an on-street accessible loading zone be designated on Woodward Avenue. The establishment of this accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curb side access to TTC Wheel-Trans service for a local resident.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate at all times on the south side of Woodward Avenue, between a point 53.5 metres east of Uphill Avenue and a point 12 metres further east.
